verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's own support docs describe a built-in export of your data in three formats: a PGP-encrypted JSON ZIP, an unencrypted ZIP, or a CSV file. JSON and CSV are open, portable formats, so you can take your data and leave. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the export covers every data type (file attachments, aliases, passkeys, SSH keys), documentation of account deletion or offboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration of export completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: If you want to use your passwords elsewhere or create a separate hardcopy, you can easily export your data from Proton Pass.
A ZIP file containing a PGP-encrypted JSON file
